macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street rebounds as Treasury yields ease
items.summary: U.S. stocks ended higher after reversing an early selloff as the benchmark Treasury yield pulled back from a 24-year high. Technology, semiconductor and energy shares led, while European stocks closed at three-month lows.

items.title: Micron outlook lifts semiconductor stocks
items.summary: Micron Technology gained after reporting stronger-than-expected quarterly results and providing an above-consensus outlook, helping drive a 1.6% gain in the semiconductor index. Accenture also rose after issuing a stronger revenue forecast.

items.title: Fed officials signal further rate increases
items.summary: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said rates may need to rise by at least 50 basis points to contain persistent inflation. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari also said additional hikes may be needed into 2027, though he was uncertain about the timing of the next move.

items.title: U.S. jobs report becomes key market catalyst
items.summary: Investors are focused on the September nonfarm-payrolls report, expected to show 90,000 new jobs with unemployment holding at 4.1%. The data is likely to influence expectations for the Federal Reserve’s next interest-rate decisions.

items.title: Dollar and oil rise amid geopolitical concerns
items.summary: The dollar reached a 17-month high against the euro as bond yields and oil prices rose. Brent crude gained about 4% amid reports of increased U.S. military activity in the Middle East, while gold benefited from reduced expectations of further Fed tightening.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rise
items.summary: Bitcoin topped $84,000, gaining 1.2% in 24 hours, while Ethereum rose 1.1% to $2,699. The overall crypto market increased 0.5% to approximately $2.88 trillion, with Solana, Dogecoin and Cardano also advancing.[6]

items.title: Crypto liquidations reach roughly $191 million
items.summary: About $191 million in cryptocurrency positions were liquidated over the past 24 hours, including approximately $107 million in long positions.[3][4]

items.title: SEC proposes changes to crypto custody rules
items.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission proposed revisions that could allow investment advisers to self-custody crypto assets under specified conditions and use state-chartered trust companies as custodians.[4]

items.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions A7 Network
items.summary: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned A7 Network over allegations that it helped Iran evade sanctions, adding potential compliance pressure for crypto businesses.[3][4]

items.title: Hong Kong flags FNXAI-linked investment products
items.summary: Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission added products linked to FNXAI and 1FNXAI to a suspected investment-products list. The products reportedly promote automated U.S. stock trading and cryptocurrency staking.[3][4]

items.title: Hyperliquid burns another $1.8 million of HYPE
items.summary: Hyperliquid reportedly bought back and burned 20,200 HYPE tokens over the past 24 hours. Cumulative burns reached about 49.09 million HYPE, valued at approximately $4.29 billion.[5]

items.title: XRP spot ETF records net inflow
items.summary: U.S. XRP spot ETFs reportedly recorded a net inflow of approximately $4.07 million on October 1, with inflows into Franklin’s product partly offset by outflows from Canary’s product.[10]

items.title: Solana rises above $120
items.summary: Solana traded above $120 on OKX, with a 24-hour gain of roughly 1.5% to 1.6%.[9][10]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI says it disrupted effort to copy AI model capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI reported disrupting a large-scale effort to replicate its AI model capabilities, highlighting continuing concerns about model theft, distillation, and competitive intelligence.

items.title: Cloudflare releases open-weight Clef decision models
items.summary: Cloudflare released Clef and Clef Flash, 27-billion- and 9-billion-parameter open-weight models designed to help AI agents select actions by returning probabilities rather than generating full text. The models use the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Argon frontier model
items.summary: Google introduced Argon as the flagship model for its Gemini 4 generation, positioning it for complex workloads including coding and cybersecurity. The company has not announced a broad public release timeline and said Gemini 3.5 Pro will not be released.

items.title: AI vulnerability disclosures reportedly doubled in 2026
items.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group reported that monthly software vulnerability disclosures doubled between January and August, reflecting changes in how AI affects vulnerability discovery and reporting.

items.title: Bank of America plans to double AI spending
items.summary: Bank of America said it plans to double AI spending next year after investing about $400 million across roughly 140 AI and machine-learning projects, with the bank estimating approximately $800 million in benefits.

items.title: Deepslate AI raises €7.7 million for speech-to-speech technology
items.summary: Berlin-based voice AI startup Deepslate raised €7.7 million in seed funding to develop a speech-to-speech model that processes audio directly.

items.title: OpenAI assigns GPT-6.1 Sol its highest cyber-risk rating
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly classified GPT-6.1 Sol at its highest cybersecurity capability level under its Preparedness Framework, matching the rating assigned to GPT-6 Astra.
